Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
In the excerpt from Game Face: Balancing Act, Halmeoni's words and actions show that the host of a tea ceremony —

A.Choice: admires her guests because she wears nice clothing for them

B.Choice: values her guests because she answers many questions for them

C.Choice: honors her guests because she saves the best cup of tea for them

D.Choice: wants to impress her guests because she sits up straight for them

Content: Which detail from the story `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

A.Choice: “'Why not dress accordingly?'” (paragraph `10`)

B.Choice: “'Keep your back straight, your shoulders strong, and chin up.'” (paragraph `15`)

C.Choice: “'Pouring it into the bowl `text(first)` allows it to cool.'” (paragraph `20`)

D.Choice: “'work backward, so that their cups will be warm for the longest amount of time'” (paragraph `25`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Read this sentence from paragraph `10` of the excerpt from Game Face: Balancing Act.
:box:“I have waited a long time to teach you about our culture's most respected `ultext(tradition)`.”
Which definition `bbtext(best)` matches the meaning of the word `bbtext(tradition)` as it is used in this sentence?

A.Choice: A shared experience

B.Choice: A special drink with family

C.Choice: An article of lovely clothing

D.Choice: A practice that is passed down

Content: Which detail from the story `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

B.Choice: “`text(one day)` it will belong to you” (paragraph `10`)

C.Choice: “saving it for a special occasion” (paragraph `10`)

D.Choice: “removed a red linen napkin” (paragraph `11`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Which theme is developed in the story “Sugar-on-Snow”?

A.Choice: Working together toward a goal is satisfying.

B.Choice: Older generations have much to teach others.

C.Choice: Trying something new can be surprisingly pleasant.

D.Choice: Family members know one another better than anyone else.

Content: Which sentences from the story `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “Chester recognizes the collapsed barn and knows they are almost at Grandpa's farm.” (paragraph `7`)

B.Choice: “'The horses won't be helping this `text(year)`.'” (paragraph `10`)

C.Choice: “When he smells the sweet steam of the boiling sap, Chester forgets about the horses.” (paragraph `13`)

D.Choice: “Mama and Chester carry wood from the woodshed into the sugarhouse for the fire.” (paragraph `14`)

E.Choice: “'Mm! Sweet and sour, sour and sweet.'” (paragraph `19`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Read this sentence from paragraph `17` in “Sugar-on-Snow.”
:box:He sticks the candy `ultext(thermometer)` into the pot.
Which definition `bbtext(best)` matches the meaning of the word `bbtext(thermometer)` as it is used in this sentence?

A.Choice: A spoon used to stir liquids

B.Choice: A tool used to hold hot foods

C.Choice: An instrument used to measure heat

D.Choice: An ingredient used to sweeten a recipe

Content: Which detail from paragraph `17` in the story `bbtext(best)` supports the definition in Part A?

A.Choice: “In the kitchen”

B.Choice: “the right temperature”

C.Choice: “maple sugar now”

D.Choice: “removes the pot”

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
In the excerpt from Game Face: Balancing Act and the story “Sugar-on-Snow,” the main characters are `bbtext(both)` —

A.Choice: in awe of their grandparents

B.Choice: curious about their grandparents

C.Choice: impatient with their grandparents

D.Choice: excited to help their grandparents

Content: Which sentences from the stories `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` story for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “Her silky black hair was pulled into a low bun, showing off her long, elegant neck and deep, dark eyes.” (paragraph `7`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

B.Choice: “'It belonged to my grandmother,' she said.” (paragraph `10`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

C.Choice: “My eager muscles already started to twitch beneath me.” (paragraph `14`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

D.Choice: “'Where are the horses?' he asks as Grandpa wraps his arms around him and hugs him.” (paragraph `9`, “Sugar-on-Snow”)

F.Choice: “He scoops up the snow, packs it in the bowl, and brings it into Grandpa's farmhouse.” (paragraph `16`, “Sugar-on-Snow”)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Which theme can be found in both the excerpt from Game Face: Balancing Act and the story “Sugar-on-Snow”?

A.Choice: Respect is something a person must earn.

B.Choice: Sometimes it is difficult to do the right thing.

C.Choice: Patience is important when listening to others.

D.Choice: There is value in spending time with older generations.

Content: Which sentences from the stories support the theme from Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` story for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers

A.Choice: “I nodded, not convinced that the extra step was needed.” (paragraph `21`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

B.Choice: “'Wait,' I said. 'You forgot to add tea leaves.'” (paragraph `23`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

C.Choice: “The farthest cup is for our most respected guest.” (paragraph `25`, Game Face: Balancing Act)

D.Choice: “Grandpa lifts him up to peer into the pan.” (paragraph `13`, “Sugar-on-Snow”)

E.Choice: “His hair is sticky from the sap steam.” (paragraph `14`, “Sugar-on-Snow”)

F.Choice: “Mama opens the jar of pickles she has brought.” (paragraph `18`, “Sugar-on-Snow”)

Content: Now that you have read the excerpt from Game Face: Balancing Act and the story “Sugar-on-Snow,” think about the main characters in `text(each story)`.
Write an essay in which you explain how `text(each main character)` changes in the story. Use details from `bbtext(both)` stories to support your essay.
:ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Which sentence states a main idea from the article about people who lived on the frontier?

A.Choice: They tried to make chores enjoyable.

B.Choice: They spent their time working alone.

C.Choice: They had to learn many new skills.

D.Choice: They were really lonely.

Content: Which detail from the article `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

A.Choice: “On the frontier, families usually lived many `text(miles)` apart.” (paragraph `1`)

B.Choice: “The men worked all `text(day)` cutting trees.” (paragraph `2`)

C.Choice: “Everyone talked, joked, and laughed as they husked.” (paragraph `3`)

D.Choice: “Together, neighbors completed other big jobs.” (paragraph `4`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
How does the photograph contribute to the reader's understanding of the article?

A.Choice: It shows that frontier women had difficult lives.

B.Choice: It shows that frontier women spent time working together.

C.Choice: It illustrates that frontier women were expected to have many skills.

D.Choice: It illustrates that frontier women were responsible for completing many tasks.

Content: Which detail from the article `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

A.Choice: “needed to clear the land” (paragraph `2`)

B.Choice: “workers divided into teams” (paragraph `2`)

C.Choice: “apple peeling, and chicken or goose plucking” (paragraph `4`)

D.Choice: “stitched while they chatted and sang” (paragraph `4`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
What information about dances is given by `bbtext(both)` the author and Peggy Bell?

A.Choice: People on the frontier knew many types of dances.

B.Choice: Dances sometimes lasted until the morning.

C.Choice: Dances were a break from difficult chores.

D.Choice: People of all ages joined in on the dances.

Content: Which details from the article `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

B.Choice: “from toddlers to grandparents” (paragraph `5`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
How does the author mainly organize the information in paragraph `9`?

B.Choice: By describing how the celebration changed over time

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
What is the overall structure of the article “Rangers Rule!”?

A.Choice: A description of the effects of being a Junior Ranger

B.Choice: A retelling of a Junior Ranger experience in time order

C.Choice: A sequence of steps on how to become a Junior Ranger

D.Choice: A comparison of the jobs of park rangers and Junior Rangers

Content: Which sentence from the article `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

A.Choice: “They do everything from teaching visitors about the park to protecting local plants and animals.” (paragraph `1`)

B.Choice: “They're the people who care for Grand Canyon National Park and other historic and beautiful places around the country.” (paragraph `1`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
In the excerpt from “Explore Awesome Parks!,” Marie helped create the Junior Ranger booklet for the new park because she wanted to —

A.Choice: get an award from her scouting group

B.Choice: pick the names for the new park mascots

C.Choice: tell other people to come see the fossils at the new park

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Read this sentence from paragraph `1` of the excerpt from “Loving the Ranger Life.”
:box:To make visits to the park fun and to show visitors the importance of being `ultext(good stewards)`.

B.Choice: “make visits to the park fun”

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
In the excerpt from “Loving the Ranger Life,” how does the author support the claim in paragraph `1` that park rangers are “historians”?

A.Choice: By describing some of the information that the rangers teach others at the parks

B.Choice: By showing that the rangers understand the skills that are needed to survive in the parks

C.Choice: By describing the past experiences that made the rangers want to work in the parks

D.Choice: By focusing on the rangers' knowledge of the types of plants and animals found in the parks

Content: Which detail from the excerpt `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A?

A.Choice: “toured many national parks when I was a kid, and I attended ranger programs” (paragraph `2`)

B.Choice: “love teaching people about nature and protecting our resources” (paragraph `2`)

C.Choice: “talk about the survival of trees, animals, and humans in winter” (paragraph `5`)

D.Choice: “help people understand why this place is important” (paragraph `7`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
The article “Rangers Rule!” and the excerpt from “Explore Awesome Parks!” `bbtext(both)` describe —

A.Choice: tasks members can do as a Junior Ranger

B.Choice: the history of park rangers in national parks

C.Choice: the role of park rangers in protecting wildlife

D.Choice: locations of national parks that have Junior Ranger programs

Content: Which sentences from the article and the excerpt `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` passage for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “But did you know that kids can be rangers too?” (paragraph `2`, “Rangers Rule!”)

B.Choice: “You probably can't stump the rangers — they're experts.” (paragraph `3`, “Rangers Rule!”)

C.Choice: “You could take a hike to see some of the canyon's fossils.” (paragraph `5`, “Rangers Rule!”)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
The article “Rangers Rule!” and the excerpt from “Loving the Ranger Life” `bbtext(both)` explain that park rangers —

A.Choice: enjoy planning adventures

B.Choice: know a lot about their park

C.Choice: mainly protect wildlife

D.Choice: work in parks and in schools

Content: Which sentences from the article and the excerpt `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` passage for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “They do everything from teaching visitors about the park to protecting local plants and animals.” (paragraph `1`, “Rangers Rule!”)

B.Choice: “`text(Once)` you're done, take your Activity Booklet back to a visitor center to have a ranger check your work.” (paragraph `6`, “Rangers Rule!”)

C.Choice: “I love to paddle, go camping, learn about ... people, share stories with others, and laugh.” (paragraph `4`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

D.Choice: “I help people plan their trip to the park, take them on guided walks, create exhibits and films for them.” (paragraph `5`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

E.Choice: “We strap on the snowshoes and walk into the snowy wonderland.” (paragraph `5`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Based on the excerpts from “Explore Awesome Parks!” and ”Loving the Ranger Life,” how do family visits help support national parks?

A.Choice: Family visits help park rangers find people to maintain and clean the parks.

B.Choice: Family visits are the main reason people visit national parks.

C.Choice: Family visits help visitors of all ages form a connection to the parks.

D.Choice: Family visits are the only way to attend the educational programs at the parks.

Content: Which details from the excerpts `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` excerpt for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “When I was `9`, I went on a cross-country trip with my parents and sister.” (paragraph `2`, “Explore Awesome Parks!”)

B.Choice: “proved to be a great way for both me and my sister (she's `text(six years)` older) to get excited about the stop” (paragraph `2`, “Explore Awesome Parks!”)

C.Choice: “I like helping people get excited about a new thing they learned about the outdoor world.” (paragraph `3`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

D.Choice: “I really enjoy watching the kids when they are totally engaged in their Junior Ranger sessions.” (paragraph `6`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

E.Choice: “talk to kids about the park's natural and cultural resources in a classroom” (paragraph `7`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
How are Marie in the excerpt from “Explore Awesome Parks!“ and the park rangers in the excerpt from “Loving the Ranger Life” alike?

A.Choice: They led educational experiences to teach about parks.

B.Choice: They helped protect land important to native people.

C.Choice: They had always dreamed of having a job in the outdoors.

D.Choice: They helped create a children's program for a national park.

Content: Which evidence from the articles `bbtext(best)` supports the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` article for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “I thought a female cartoon mammoth would be a great mascot — the result is Wanda.” (paragraph `5`, “Explore Awesome Parks!”)

B.Choice: “as well as leading educational tours for Girl Scouts and other kids at the park” (paragraph `5`, “Explore Awesome Parks!”)

C.Choice: “always been my dream to have a job where I can spend a lot of time outdoors” (paragraph `4`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

D.Choice: “I travel by small planes to remote ... villages to teach Inupiaq Eskimo children in their schools.” (paragraph `6`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

E.Choice: “Apostle Islands is considered sacred to native people, so it makes me feel good that I can help protect it.” (paragraph `7`, “Loving the Ranger Life”)

Content: Now that you have read “Rangers Rule!” and the excerpts from “Explore Awesome Parks!“ and “Loving the Ranger Life,” think about the Junior Ranger program.
Write an essay in which you explain how the activities of the Junior Ranger program preserve and build interest in national parks. Use details from all `bbtext(three)` passages to support your essay.
